newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended Monday's session with a slightly weaker bias, under pressure from declines in other major debt markets.
Traders said activity was exceptionally quiet on modest volumes.
Technical analysts at Credit Suisse First Boston said in a weekly study that the Swiss Conf future should consolidate in the 116.60 to 117.00 range near-term.
"A break of the medium-term uptrend is rather unlikely with the current technical constellation. The uptrend should persist towards the end of the first quarter," CSFB said.
March Conf futures down eight at 117.18.
March Comi medium-term bond down 31 at 111.17
Mar Euro Swiss francs down two at 98.16.
